title: Jazzy Light German Haggis Curry
description: A quick-fix, anti-inflammatory-friendly dish that brings together the flavors of Germany and Scotland. Perfect for a weekday dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the haggis and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder, turmeric, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with rice or naan bread, if desired.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro.
